```{r}
library(png)
```

#read in intermediates
```{r}

#A (tapestation)
af_4a <- png::readPNG("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/figures/af_scheme.png")

#B C D (q vs length)
p4_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/intermediates/p4_b.rds")
p4_c <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/intermediates/p4_c.rds")
p4_d <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/intermediates/p4_d.rds")

#E (retention)
p4_e <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel4/intermediates/p4_e.rds")
  
#F G (length)
```

-----layout 2

```{r}
p4_a <- p4_a + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=15, 5, 5, 5))) 
p4_a_b <- plot_grid(p4_a, p4_b, labels = c("a", "b"), label_size=7, nrow=2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 1.0)
p4_a_b
```


```{r}
p4_c_d <- plot_grid(p4_c, p4_d, labels = c("c", "d"), label_size=7, nrow=2, hjust=-0.8, vjust=1.0, rel_heights = c(1,0.85))
p4_c_d
```

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4}
p4_top <- plot_grid(p4_a_b, p4_c_d, ncol=2, rel_widths = c(0.85, 1))
p4_top
```

```{r, fig.height=4}
p4_e_h <- plot_grid(p4_e, p4_h, nrow=2, labels = c("e", "h"), label_size=7, rel_heights = c(1,1))
#p4_e_h
```

e, h, f, g
```{r, fig.width=7}
p4_bot <- plot_grid(p4_e_h, p4_f_g, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.85,1))
p4_bot
```

```{r, fig.height=8.5, fig.width=7}
p4_combined <- plot_grid(p4_top, p4_bot, nrow=2, rel_heights=c(0.85,1))
p4_combined
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p4.pdf", plot=p4_combined,width = 7.5, height = 8.5)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p4.png", plot=p4_combined,width = 7.5, height = 8.5)
```
